notes.title: 🔥 Brace Yourselves – Arcane Lust 18+ is Almost Here! 🔥
notes.notes:
[h3]We’re in the final stretch of polishing Arcane Lust 18+, and while we need just a little more time to make it perfect, we’re beyond excited to announce that [b]the game officially drops this Saturday![/b] 🎉

Big shoutout to you all for your patience – this extra time lets us fine-tune every spicy scene, every wild twist, and every moment of survival with your glitchy fox-girl companion. Aelin’s got her eyes (and tracker) locked on you, and trust us, things are about to get intense. 👀🔥

Can you survive 10 chaotic days in a fantasy android theme park, balancing Aelin’s emotions while uncovering the dark secrets lurking beneath the surface? No pressure… but your choices literally mean everything.

🚀[b] Wishlist the game, mark your calendars, and get ready to dive into Arcane Lust 18+ this Saturday![/b]

[b]The wait is almost over – and it’s gonna be WILD.[/b] 💦🤖✨[/h3]
